channel.title: Latch
channel.description: Updates for Latch, a grid window manager for macOS.

item.title: Latch 1.0.2
item.description:
• Describe the release as it is now: one command
  • Make a release one command with nothing to prepare
  • Ship a release with one command
  • Let a placement drag start from any cell
  • Turn the licensing plan into a record of what was built
  • Sell Latch from inside Latch
  • Notice when Accessibility access goes away, and say so
  • Stop every install from revoking Accessibility
  • Open System Settings via the modern Privacy pane
